ICI India Research and Technology Centre Private Limited (hereinafter ICI R&T) (formerly ICI India Research and Technology Centre) was originally registered (on 30th August 1976) as a Section 25 company under the erstwhile Companies Act, 1956 (now Section 8 under Companies Act, 2013) and was a company limited by guarantee without any share capital with Rs. 100/- as amount of guarantee. During the financial year 20222023, ICI R&T applied to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) for conversion of itself from a Section 25 (Sec. 8) company to a private company limited by guarantee by way of surrendering its license u/s 25 (Sec 8).
Pursuant to MCA approval (dt. 10th May 2024) to the aforesaid conversion, ICI R&T stood converted into a private company limited by guarantee from a Section 8 company. Subsequently, on further application for conversion, and pursuant to the necessary statutory filings and approvals, MCA approved ICI R&T conversion into a private company limited by shares vide a fresh certificate of incorporation (dated 22nd August 2024). Consequent to such conversion, 100 equity shares of INR 1/- each of ICI R&T have been allotted to the four guarantor-members (Akzo Nobel India Limited and 3 resident individuals) in the proportion of their respective amounts of guarantee (aggregating to INR 100/-) as held by them prior to such conversion.
Subsequently, on 31st March 2025, ICI R&T has issued and allotted 12,50,000 equity shares of INR 1/- each to Akzo Nobel India Limited under Rights Issue.
Before conversion the voting right was 25% and after converting to a sharebased company the voting right was 50% out of a the total equity capital of Rs 100/-. After subscribing to the rights issue the voting right of the Company became 99.99% out of the equity capital of Rs 12,50,100/-
